diagnosis: Pretrained baseline reproduced (2.65 WER on the fixed 15-utt subset), so the eval harness is sound.
QAT loss drops to 1.92 during the alpha ramp, then spikes to 15.06 at alpha=1 and settles ~7 -> quantization transition is not being trained stably.
Post-training fp16 (alpha=0) WER 256% means the shadow weights themselves were corrupted, not just the quantized readout.
LoRA was unavailable (torchao too old), so the fallback trained BitLinear shadows; the corruption persists.
Suspects: (a) gradient checkpointing interacting with the custom STE/patched forward, (b) lr too high for full shadow updates, (c) tiny 48-example train set overfitting, (d) Adam8bit state.

Use bf16/fp16 autocast, lower lr, longer warmup, and a larger labelled subset.
